items.headline: O: ChatGPT combines text, visuals, interactive tools
items.summary: ChatGPT release notes add the ability to combine text with visuals and interactive elements (e.g., calculator-style tools) to answer questions more directly inside the chat.

items.headline: G: Muse Spark Open on GroqCloud (limited preview)
items.summary: G announces Meta’s “Muse Spark Open” is available on GroqCloud in limited preview, highlighting model specs (parameters, context, throughput) and an agentic coding focus.

items.headline: O: GPT‑6 Sol & Luna October update
items.summary: O’s deployment safety hub publishes an October update for GPT‑6 Sol and GPT‑6 Luna, describing safety categorization and prepared deployment changes for the new GPT‑6 family.

items.headline: O: Atlassian partnership expansion
items.summary: O reports an expansion with Atlassian to bring frontier GPT‑6 family models across Atlassian’s platform, aimed at turning enterprise knowledge into actionable workflows.
